description: A Replay Vision action: a scheduled "and then…" automation over a scanner's observations.

alert_config.description: Alert condition; required when mode is 'alert', ignored otherwise.

direction.description:
Which side of the threshold breaches: 'above' fires when the metric is at or above it, 'below' when at or below (e.g. an average score dropping under a floor). Both inclusive. Defaults to 'above'; ignored for every_match.

* `above` - At or above
* `below` - At or below

frequency.description:
'every_match' notifies about every new matching observation (batched per check); 'on_breach' notifies once when the threshold condition starts holding. Defaults to 'on_breach'.

* `every_match` - Every new match
* `on_breach` - When a threshold is crossed

include_reasoning.description: When true, each example line in the alert message includes the scanner's full reasoning for that observation, not just its verdict/score/tags. Useful when piping the message somewhere else to read or act on. Defaults to false.

metric.description:
What to measure over the window: 'count' of targeted observations, or 'avg_score' (the mean scorer score; scorer scanners only). every_match supports 'count' only.

* `count` - Count of matching observations
* `avg_score` - Average score

threshold.description: The alert fires when the metric is at or above ('above') or at or below ('below') this value, per 'direction'. Required for on_breach; ignored for every_match.

window_days.description:
Rolling lookback window for on_breach conditions, ending at each check. Defaults to 1 day. every_match ignores it (each check covers what's new since the previous one).

* `1` - 1 day
* `3` - 3 days
* `7` - 7 days
* `14` - 14 days
* `30` - 30 days

delivery_config.description: List of delivery destinations the synthesized summary is sent to.

items.description: A single delivery destination: a Slack channel or an HTTP webhook URL.

channel.description: Slack channel ID or name the summary is posted to. Required when type is 'slack'.

integration_id.description: ID of the Slack Integration on this team used to deliver. Required when type is 'slack'.

type.description:
Destination type: 'slack' posts to a Slack channel; 'webhook' POSTs a JSON payload to a URL.

* `slack` - Slack
* `webhook` - Webhook

url.description: HTTPS endpoint the summary is POSTed to as JSON. Required when type is 'webhook'. Redacted to scheme+host in responses for users without editor access to the scanner.

enabled.description: When false, the scheduler skips this action.

is_scanner_digest.description: Marks this action as the scanner's built-in daily digest, the one summary surfaced on the scanner overview. At most one digest per scanner.

mode.description:
What the action produces. MVP supports 'group_summary' only.

* `group_summary` - Group summary
* `alert` - Alert
* `per_observation` - Per observation

name.description: Human-readable action name. Unique within the team.

scanner.description: Scanner whose observations this action operates on. Must belong to the same team.

selection.description: Targeting predicate: which of the scanner's observations this action runs on.

max_score.description: Only run on scorer observations with a score at or below this value (inclusive).

min_score.description: Only run on scorer observations with a score at or above this value (inclusive).

scanner_ids.description: Restrict to observations produced by these scanner IDs. Defaults to the bound scanner.

tags.description: Only run on classifier observations carrying any of these tags (fixed or freeform).

verdict.description: Only run on monitor observations with one of these verdicts (yes/no/inconclusive).

synthesis_config.description: Synthesis options for the group summary, e.g. {prompt_guide}.

prompt_guide.description: Free-form guidance steering how the group summary is written.

trigger_config.description: Trigger parameters. For schedule triggers: {rrule, timezone}.

rrule.description: iCal RRULE string controlling the schedule cadence (no DTSTART — the start is managed separately).

timezone.description: IANA timezone name the RRULE is expanded in, e.g. 'Europe/Prague'. Defaults to 'UTC'.

trigger_type.description:
What fires the action. MVP supports 'schedule' only.

* `schedule` - Schedule
* `threshold` - Threshold
